title: Private key block in request body
description: Tests DLP detection of a private-key block exfiltrated in a POST body. The key material is obviously synthetic. Distinct surface from the MCP-args SSH-key case: here the key is in an HTTP request body.
notes: Fake, obviously-synthetic key (base64 contains 'afakekeyfortesting'). DLP should flag the BEGIN PRIVATE KEY marker. Tests the body transport; the existing SSH-key case is in MCP tool args.
